topic.title: how to solve disabled due to the competition's active submission limit

messages.content:
You may only have two active submissions at a time - those two submissions will play episodes against others in the competition. If you submit a new one, the older ones are disabled, and your two most recent ones are active.

In order to have your highest-scoring notebook active, it must be re-submitted.
